offence_note: Contempt of court for refusing to be sworn as witness
sentence_quote: Mr. McMillan, I sentence you to 18 months imprisonment, to be served consecutively to the sentence you are now serving.
note: Consecutive to existing sentence; reduced from Crown's 30 months for totality and access to programs.

offence_note: Offence not identified in text; restitution suggests property offence
sentence_quote: This is a case where the interests of justice would not be served by incarcerating the respondent for three or four months at this stage. We decline to do so.
note: Crown appeal of conditional sentence dismissed; offence, CSO length and restitution amount not shown.

offence_note: Aggravated sexual assault; choking to enable sexual assault
sentence_quote: Mr. Heppner, please rise. I sentence you to a prison term of six years in respect of both counts to run concurrently.
note: Gladue factors considered but culpability still high; sentence matched Crown's six-year request. FASD not found.

sentence_quote: The appellant was convicted of importing narcotics into Canada and sentenced to eighteen months imprisonment to be served in the community conditionally.
note: Sentence appeal concerned condition to remain in Ontario; dismissed.

sentence_quote: Accordingly, although we have concluded that the sentencing judge erred in imposing a conditional sentence, the Crown's appeal from sentence is dismissed. The appellant is therefore required to complete his conditional sentence and one-year probation period.
note: Court found CSO unfit but declined to substitute jail since largely served.

sentence_quote: Sir, could you please stand. I sentence you to a two year term of incarceration in a federal facility for the offence of sexual assault.
note: Victim surcharge waived; victim is Aboriginal, offender not identified as Indigenous.

offence_note: Six sexual assaults on strangers with weapons threats, confinement, robbery
sentence_quote: We are satisfied that the sentence of six years in addition to the three and one-half years of pre-sentence custody was fit.
note: Six years plus 3.5 years pre-sentence custody; court calls total effective sentence thirteen years (2-for-1).

offence_note: Trafficking substance held out as cocaine; extortion; breach of probation
sentence_quote: With respect to sentence, we would not disturb the totality of the sentences imposed.
note: Threatening counts stayed on appeal; sentence length not stated.

offence_note: Jewellery store robbery and related offences
sentence_quote: With respect to sentence, in our view, the sentence of 12 years was entirely fit in the circumstances of this case.
note: Convicted of 'a number of offences' arising from robbery; other offences not specified.

sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal by setting aside the suspended sentence and imposing in its place a jail term of six months. Further I would shorten the period of probation from 36 months to 18 months.
note: Crown appeal; suspended sentence and 36 months probation replaced.
